editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and realizing the police think you look exactly like a dangerous killer. That is the nightmare you get into with this story. You follow a regular bank clerk in Ohio who just wants to live a quiet life, but everything flips upside down when a witness describes a murderer who looks just like him. The vibe is very tense and makes you feel the panic of being hunted for something you did not do. You will find yourself rooting for him as he tries to clear his name while the real bad guy is still out there somewhere.

The acting is surprisingly good for an older film, and the plot keeps you guessing about who the real killer is. It moves quickly and does not waste your time with boring scenes. While some of the special effects look dated, the suspense still works great. If you love old-school mysteries, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when the clerk finally traps the real killer in a high-stakes confrontation. It turns out the killer was someone close by who used the clerk's looks as a cover. After a tense chase, the police arrive just in time to see the killer caught red-handed. The clerk is fully cleared of all charges, and he finally gets his peaceful life back now that the truth is out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old crime mysteries and wrong-man stories.
